title: Revitalize color grammar and typographic scale for datagrid and action controls
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Our current visual constants create subtle visual noise in dense tables and make primary/secondary actions feel inconsistent across density modes. We see token drift: multiple legacy blue/teal variants used by table rows, badges, and action buttons; inconsistent type scales between compact and default; and elevation shadows that don't read at small sizes. This ticket scopes a focused overhaul of the color grammar, a small but prescriptive typographic scale for table and control surfaces, and a compact-radius system for density variants.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Establish a single semantic color grammar (semantic names) covering surface, emphasis, interactive, success/warn/error with explicit contrast ratios for text on primary/secondary/disabled surfaces.
A2: Provide a 3-step typographic scale mapped to density (compact / default / comfortable) with clear line-height and token names for use in datagrid cells, row actions, and pill labels.
A3: Define radius tokens for three density tiers and document interaction touch-target guidance; tokens must be implementable with CSS variables and token export in Figma.
A4: Define three elevation shadow tokens (e1, e2, e3) with variants for small UI elements (<=32px) and larger surfaces; demonstrate readability tests on datagrid rows and floating menus.
A5: Update components library stories for Table, Button, Badge, and Menu to consume new tokens and pass visual diff tests in Chromatic with no regressions for key flows.
A6: Include an accessibility checklist showing contrast ratio measurements and examples where a darker emphasis color is used for small-cap labels.
A7: Share rollout guidance for engineers to enable opt-in token switch (feature flag for migration) and a deprecation plan for legacy variables.
design_notes: Figma core file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Design-System-Q1-2025 (page: Color + Typography). Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Color+Grammar+and+Typo+Refresh. Prototype (interactive datagrid): https://www.figma.com/proto/abcd1234/datagrid-prototype. GitHub sandbox branch: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/tree/feat/ds-token-refresh.
decisions: Use semantic tokens (surface, accent, interactive, muted, danger, success, warning) instead of ad-hoc color names to reduce duplication in components.
Ship a narrow typographic scale that only changes font-size for 3 density tiers; preserve brand display sizes elsewhere to limit regressions.
Adopt a 'radius by density' approach: radii = {compact: 4px, default: 8px, comfortable: 12px} (token names: radius-compact, radius-default, radius-comfortable).
Introduce micro-elevation variants for small elements: elevation-xs, elevation-sm, elevation-md. For small elements (<=32px) use elevation-xs to avoid heavy drop shadows.
Prefer higher-contrast emphasis for labels smaller than 12px to meet AA/AAA where required; fallback tokens provided for legacy palettes.
Migration pattern: provide token aliases that map legacy tokens to new semantic tokens for a 3-release deprecation window.
Avoid changing primary brand hue; changes are limited to semantic mapping and accessible contrast tuning only.
